title: HORUS-Cytomegalovirus Open Proof-of-concept Exploratory trial
summary: Main objective: To evaluate whether an immune modulation strategy (50% reduction in MPA dosing or a switch to everolimus) leads to a significant reduction in CMV viral load in each intervention arm, relative to maintaining the standard immunosuppressive regimen in patients with CMV infection receiving antiviral therapy.
conditions: Cytomegalovirus infection in solid-organ transplant recipients.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Clinically stable adult patients (aged 18 years or older) who have received a solid organ transplant (e.g., kidney, liver, heart, lung, pancreas) and developed clinically significant CMV infection as determined by positive CMV PCR.
2. On maintenance therapy of tacrolimus, MPA, +/- steroids.
3. Informed consent signed.
Exclusion criteria:
1. Active acute graft rejection or significant graft dysfunction requiring modification of the current immunosuppressive regimen, in the opinion of the investigator.
2. Receipt of more than 72 hours of antiviral therapy for CMV infection prior to enrolment, before randomization, including valganciclovir and/or IV ganciclovir therapy.
3. Known intolerance or hypersensitivity to mTOR inhibitors or to any component of the everolimus formulation.
4. Any medical condition that constitutes a contraindication to everolimus use, as judged by the investigator.
5. Additional exclusion criteria for French sites:  Patient not affiliated to the French social security system OR Patient under legal protection (guardianship, curatorship).
